title: London sightseeing – A2 English Listening Test

seo.title: London sightseeing – A2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Listening comprehension test for pre-intermediate students (CEFR A2 level). Watch a video about traveling in London and answer the questions.

parts:
A2 English Listening Test

Watch a video about the main tourist attractions in London. For questions 1 to 6, choose the correct answer.

For more videos like this, go to Loescher Editore video
Questions

choices.html: They had to close it because of the bad weather.
There was a problem and was closed temporarily.

questions.prompt: At St Paul's Cathedral, you can go up ...

choices.html: 530 steps and see a view of London.
513 steps and see a view of London.

questions.prompt: About the changing of the guard, they say that ...

choices.html: you should arrive early to see it.

questions.prompt: About Tower Bridge, they say that you can ...

choices.html: walk from one tower to the other of the bridge.
see big boats crossing the bridge every 15 minutes.
